title: Ticket naming
description:
Tickets should only show the title, with a "more details" button to show the full description.

**Requirements:**
- Display only ticket title in list view
- Add "More Details" button to expand full description
- Toggle show/hide functionality for description
- Keep title visible at all times

**Implementation Steps:**
1. Modify TicketList.vue component
2. Add collapsible description section
3. Add "More Details" / "Show Less" button
4. Test expand/collapse functionality
